T: › [ T ] to hit someone or something noisily
T + adv/prep: › [ T + adv/prep ] UK informal to quickly put something somewhere

C: › [ C ] the action of hitting someone or something noisily

S or U: › [ S or U ] UK informal a share or part
› US informal to try to do something
› the highest possible price or payment

NONE: › not operating correctly or looking right
出毛病的，不正常的

example: He whacked the tree trunk with his stick.
他用手杖猛擊樹幹。
She whacked him in the mouth.
她猛地一拳打在他的嘴上。
"Where shall I put my bag?" "Just whack it in the corner there."
「我把書包放在哪裡？」「丟到那邊角落裡就行。」
He gave the ball a whack with his stick.
他用球棒猛擊了一下球。
Low earners will pay only half the charge but high earners will have to pay full whack (= pay the whole amount).
低收入人士只需支付一半的費用，而高收入人士則需支付全額費用。
That's not a fair whack.
這一份太少了。
Take a whack at the homework, then ask for help if you need it.
試試做一下功課，需要的時候請人幫忙。
They're prepared to pay top whack for goods like this.
他們願意為這樣的貨物出最高價格。
You can use Carol's old bike - the gears are out of whack, but it still goes.
你可以騎卡羅爾的舊腳踏車——齒輪可能有點問題，但還能騎。

NONE: › someone who is very strange or has mental problems
怪人；腦子有問題的人

example: Stay away from him - he's a real whack job.
離他遠點兒——他可是個怪人。

NONE: › informal very tired
（感覺或看上去）極為疲憊的，筋疲力盡的
› US informal suffering the effects of drugs or alcohol
（吸毒或喝酒後）行為不正常的，思維糊塗的
› UK informal strange or unusual
奇怪的；不同尋常的

example: Here's a glass of wine, honey - you look whacked.
這裡有一杯酒，親愛的——你看起來累壞了。
He was whacked-out on speed, jabbering a mile a minute and making no sense at all.
他吸了安非他命，神志恍惚，嘴裡連珠炮似的不知在說些甚麼。
His story sounded totally whacked, but it was true.
他講的事聽起來荒誕不經，但卻是真實的。

NONE: › very big
極大的，巨大的

example: a whacking (great) boulder
巨石
a whacking fine
巨額罰款

NONE: › strange or unusual
奇怪的；不同尋常的

example: The place is stuffed with whacky memorabilia like a sculpture of the Seven Dwarfs that Walt Disney gave to Debbie Reynolds.
這個地方堆滿了古怪的紀念品，比如沃爾特．迪士尼送給黛比．雷諾茲的七個小矮人雕像。

NONE: B1 a very large sea mammal that breathes air through a hole at the top of its head
鯨
› a boat that is designed for hunting whales, or a person who works on such a boat
捕鯨船；捕鯨人
› the activity of hunting whales
捕鯨
› used to suggest the sound of a sudden hit
（表示重擊聲）砰；啪
› used to show that something you are describing happened suddenly
（表示事情的突然發生）砰；啪

example: The boys in the cartoon were punching each other - wham, zap!
卡通片裡的男孩正在打鬥——砰，啪！
Everything was fine until, wham, the wire snapped.
一切都很好，可突然啪的一聲，電線斷了。

NONE: › a magical spell or power that causes someone to have a difficult or unpleasant time
晦氣，黴運

example: He put the whammy on me.
他帶給我一身晦氣。

NONE: › an area like a wide wall built near the edge of the sea or a river where ships can be tied and goods can be taken off them
碼頭；停泊處

example: The crates were unloaded onto the wharf.
箱子卸下來，放在碼頭上。

NONE: A1 used to ask for information about people or things
甚麼
› used in questions that show you are surprised or do not believe something
（用於疑問句中，表示驚奇或不相信）
B2 used to ask about the reason for something
（用於詢問事情的原因）
› used to ask someone to say something again
（用於請某人重複所說的話）
B1 the thing(s) that; that which
（作關係代詞引導從句）…那樣的；…的
› used to introduce something you are going to say
（用於引出要說的話）
B1 used to introduce your opinion
（用於引出自己的觀點）

example: What time is it?
幾點了？
What books did you buy?
你買了甚麼書？
What did you wear?
你穿的是甚麼？
What size shoes do you take?
你穿多大尺碼的鞋？
What happened after I left?
我離開後發生了甚麼事？
What caused the accident?
是甚麼導致了那場事故？
"I just told Peter." "What?/You did what?"
「我剛剛告訴了彼得。」「甚麼？／你做了甚麼？」
What's this I hear? You're leaving?
甚麼？你要離開？
What are these tools for?
這些工具是做甚麼用的？
What are you doing that for?
你那樣做目的何在？
"We need a bigger car." "What for?"
「我們需要一輛更大的汽車。」「為甚麼？」
What I wanted to find out first was how long it was going to take.
我首先想要搞清楚的是要花多長時間。
What really concerned her was how unhappy the child was.
她真正擔心的是那孩子有多麼不開心。
She wouldn't tell me what he said.
她不願告訴我他說過甚麼。
I didn't have much money on me but I gave them what I had.
我身上沒帶多少錢，但我把帶的錢都給他們了。
The letter showed clearly what they were planning.
這封信很清楚地說明了他們是在籌劃甚麼。
I can't decide what to do next.
我決定不下來下一步該做甚麼。
Have you thought about what to send as a present?
你想過寄甚麼禮物了嗎？
You'll never guess what - Laurie won first prize!
你永遠也猜不到——勞里得了冠軍。
I'll tell you what - we'll pick up something to eat on our way home.
我告訴你——我們在回家的路上買些東西吃。
"She can't come." "What a shame/pity."
「她來不了。」「真遺憾。」
What an amazing view!
多美麗的景色啊！
What nonsense!
一派胡言！
What strange clothes he was wearing.
他穿的衣服可真奇怪。
"I think we should leave at twelve." "What?" "I said I think we should leave at twelve."
「我覺得我們應該12點離開。」「甚麼？」「我說我覺得我們應該12點離開。」

NONE: › why
為甚麽

example: What did you do that for?
你為甚麽那麽做？
What are you emptying that cupboard for?
你為甚麽把那個櫥櫃裡的東西都拿出來？

NONE: › used to mean that something was annoying and caused a lot of trouble for you
真麻煩！

example: It took ages to put together the documentation needed to get into the country - what a business!
花了好長時間才將入境所需的文件整理好——真是件麻煩事！

NONE: A2 used to suggest something
（用於徵求意見）…怎麼樣?

example: What about Lola - Shall we invite her?
洛拉呢——我們該不該邀請她？
What about taking a few days off?
休假幾天怎麼樣？

NONE: › something you say to show that you think a suggestion is stupid
多可笑的想法！

example: I can't turn up at a funeral in a pink jacket. What an idea!
我不能穿粉紅色的夾克去參加葬禮。多可笑的建議！

NONE: › said to a friend who has thanked you for doing something special for them
否則要朋友幹甚麽？
› used to say that there is nothing you can do to make a situation better
（用於無計可施時）你又能有甚麼辦法？
› used when someone has said or done something silly
（用於表示某人的言行很愚蠢）…怎麽這個樣子？

example: "Of course Emma's only worry was whether her lipstick had smudged." "Emma! What is she like?"
「當然了，愛瑪關心的只是她的口紅是否弄花了。」「愛瑪，她怎麽這個樣子？」

NONE: › used to say that it is very likely that something is true or will happen
極有可能
› used to ask someone to explain why they have done something bad
你還有甚麽好說的？ 你如何解釋？

example: Well, you've ruined my car - what have you got to say for yourself?
噢，你把我的車弄壞了——你想怎麽解釋？

NONE: › used to show that you are annoyed or that you disagree
（表示惱火或不同意）你這是甚麼意思？

example: What do you mean, it was my fault?
你這是甚麼意思，是我的錯嗎？

NONE: › a way of asking what the purpose of (doing) something is
…有甚麼用

example: What good is sitting alone in your room?
一個人孤零零地在家坐著又有甚麼用？

NONE: › used to say that you want something very much
很想得到，渴望得到

example: What I wouldn't give for a cold drink!
我多想來杯冷飲啊！

NONE: B1 used to ask about something that could happen in the future, especially something bad
如果（尤指糟糕的情況出現）會怎麼樣?

example: What if the bus is late?
要是公車誤點怎麼辦？
What if you don't pass your exams?
要是考試不及格怎麼辦？

NONE: › said to ask someone to describe someone or something to you
他／她／它／他們（等等）是甚麼樣的?

example: What was her boyfriend like?
她男朋友長甚麼樣？
"What was the weather like?" "It rained all week."
「天氣怎麼樣？」「整整一週都在下雨。」
You've seen their new house, haven't you? What's it like?
你已經看過他們的新房子了，是不是？是甚麼樣的？

NONE: A2 something you say to ask someone to describe someone or something
…怎麽樣？

example: You've met Jane's new girlfriend, haven't you? What's she like?
你見過珍的新女友了，對吧？她長得甚麽樣？
I've never been to Bruges - what's it like?
我從未去過布魯日——那裡怎麽樣？
So what's it like, then, not having to work?
不用去工作了，感覺怎麽樣？

NONE: › If you know what makes someone tick, you understand why that person behaves the way he or she does.
使（某人）做…的原因
› used to say that someone should be grateful for what they have or have been offered, and not demand something better
知足常樂（用來表示某人應對其所擁有的或別人所提供的表示感激，而不應當得寸進尺）

example: They've given him a holiday in Italy. What more does he want - jam on it?
他們已經讓他到義大利度假。他還想要甚麼呢？不要得寸進尺！

NONE: › used to rudely say that you do not think something is important
那又怎麼樣呢？那又有甚麼關係？

example: "That's the third time you've done that!" "Yeah, what of it?"
「你那樣做已經是第三次了！」「是啊，那又怎麼樣呢？」

NONE: › said when you think it is possible that the admiration, success, etc. that has been achieved was not worth all the suffering it has caused
名聲／勝利／成功等又有甚麼用？

example: What price victory when so many people have died in the struggle?
這麼多人在這場鬥爭中失去了生命，勝利又有甚麼用呢？

NONE: › how strong, clever, or brave someone is
（某人）的真本事

example: The race next week will be a chance for her to show what she's made of.
下周的賽跑是她大顯身手的機會。

NONE: › said to mean that you must do whatever a particular person says
（某人）怎麽說就得怎麽做；服從（某人的）命令

example: Around here, kid, what I say, goes!
老兄，在這裡，我怎麽說就怎麽做！

NONE: › used to give force to something you feel angry about
（用於增強憤怒的語氣）到底…？ 究竟…？

example: What the blazes did he do that for?
他到底為甚麽那麽做?

NONE: › used to say that you will do something although you know you should not do it
管它的（表示要做明知不應該做的事）

example: The doctor said I shouldn't drink, but what the heck.
醫生說我不能喝酒，管他的。

NONE: › said when you suddenly realize that your plan is not important to you and that you will do something else
管它的，沒關係

example: I was supposed to be working this evening but what the hell - I'll see you at the bar in half an hour.
今晚我本來應該工作的，但這也沒關係——我們半小時後酒吧見。

NONE: C2 used to talk about the reasons for a particular situation, especially a bad or difficult situation
（尤指糟糕或困難的局面）因為，由於

example: I'm very tired, what with travelling all day yesterday and having a disturbed night.
我非常累，因為昨天旅行了一整天，而且晚上又被吵得沒睡好。

NONE: › You say what with one thing and another when you want to explain that the reason you have failed to do something is because you have been very busy.
因為事情一件接著一件，因為忙得不可開交

example: What with one thing and another, I forgot to call you yesterday.
由於昨天事情一件接著一件，我忘了給你打電話。

NONE: › said to mean that the positive and negative results of a situation or action balance each other
有得也有失；有利也有弊；失之東隅，收之桑榆

example: "The route through town would be shorter, but there'll be more traffic." "Well, it's just swings and roundabouts."
「穿過市鎮的這條路更近一些，但是車也更多。」「哦！就是有利也有弊。」

NONE: › said to show that there is nothing hidden
所見即所得；一目了然

example: See also
WYSIWYG

NONE: › short form of what is or what has
（what is 或 what has 的縮略形式）

example: What's (= what is) that stuff on your forehead?
你前額上的是什麼東西？
They want a list of what's (= what has) been stolen.
他們想要一個失竊物品的清單。

NONE: › used to ask about what is happening or what someone is planning
發生甚麽事了？怎麽回事？要做什麼？

example: Hi there! What's cooking? Are we going out?
嗨！要做什麼？你要出去嗎？

NONE: › said when you cannot change something that has already happened
事已至此。
› used to ask why someone seems angry or upset
是甚麽使…煩心？

example: Jack's in a strange mood - I wonder what's eating him?
傑克今天脾氣怪怪的，甚麼事讓他那麼煩啊？

NONE: › said when you want to know what someone will give you if you give them the piece of information they have asked for
對我會有甚麼好處呢?

example: "Do you know where Dave's living now?" "What's it worth?"
「你知不知道戴夫現在住在哪裡？」「告訴你對我有甚麼好處？」

NONE: B2 used to add something surprising or interesting to what you have just said
而且；更有意思（或驚人）的是

example: The decorations were absolutely beautiful and what's more, the children had made them themselves.
那些裝飾絕對很漂亮，而且都是孩子們自己做的。

NONE: › used to say that you think something is very good, and that nobody could disagree with your opinion
（表示認為非常好）有什麼不好的呢？

example: It's a big house with a swimming pool. What's not to like?
一座帶著游泳池的大屋，還能有什麼不好的呢？

NONE: › used to mean "what is happening". This phrase is often used as the title of the part of a newspaper that tells you about events and entertainment happening in the next week or month.
正在發生的事（常用在報紙的標題中，用來預告下週或下個月將發生的大事或娛樂事件）
› said to emphasize that if one person is allowed to do something or to behave in a particular way, then another person must be allowed to do that thing or behave in that way, too
適用於此者也應適用於彼；應該一視同仁
› said when you want to know the reason for something
…有甚麼用？…是怎麼回事？

example: What's all this shouting in aid of?
這大喊大叫的到底怎麼回事？

NONE: › used when you do not understand why something or someone is so popular or fashionable
（用於表示不理解為甚麼某人或某物如此流行）那算是甚麼?

example: Pierced tongues - what's that about, then?
在舌頭上穿孔——那算是甚麼？

NONE: › used to say that it is very likely that something is true or will happen
很可能（是真的或會發生）

example: What's the betting Dan forgets to bring the tickets?
丹十之八九會忘了帶票，你敢打賭嗎？

NONE: › used to ask someone why they have done something annoying
你這是甚麼意思?

example: What's the big idea? I was watching that programme!
你怎麼回事？我正在看那個節目呢！

NONE: › used to ask how much you have to pay for something
花了多少錢？
› used to ask what the usual, correct way of doing or getting something is
通常都怎麽辦？正確的步驟是甚麽？

example: What's the drill for getting paid for my expenses?
報銷費用的步驟是什麼？

NONE: › said to a child who has not said "please" when asking for something
該怎麼說呢？（讓孩子要東西時說「請」字的用語）
› used to ask someone about what is going to happen, especially when arrangements have been confused
（尤指安排被打亂時）情況怎麽樣？

example: What's the score, then - are they coming?
情況怎麽樣？——他們要來嗎？

NONE: › used to tell someone to stop worrying because worrying will not help
（用於勸告某人不要爲某事擔心）…有甚麽用?

example: Try not to get depressed - after all, what's the use of worrying?
不要沮喪——話說回來，擔心又有甚麽用呢？

NONE: › something you say that means that life is not as pleasant or safe as it was in the past
世界變成什麼樣了？（抱怨生活不像過去那樣舒適或安全了）

example: What's the world coming to when you can't leave your house for five minutes without someone trying to break in and rob you?
現在你離開家僅五分鐘就可能遭人進屋洗劫，這是甚麼世道啊！

NONE: › used to ask someone what the problem is
怎麼了？出甚麼事了？

example: What's up - why does everyone look so serious?
怎麼了——為甚麼大家看起來都這麼嚴肅？
What's up with Terry?
特裡怎麼了？

NONE: › the facts of a situation
事情的真相

example: Gloria will know what's what.
格洛裡亞知道真相。

NONE: › something you ask when you want to know what someone is doing or secretly planning to do
你在玩甚麽把戲？你在搞甚麽鬼？

example: The porter saw me climbing over the wall and shouted "Hey you, what's your game?"
守門人看到我翻牆，大聲叫道：「哎，你在搞甚麽鬼？」

NONE: › used for referring to a woman or girl when you cannot remember or do not know her name
名叫某某的她，某個她（用於忘記女子的名字時）

example: I gave the report to what's-her-name - the new marketing assistant.
我把報告給了那個叫甚麼來著——就是那個新的市場助理。

NONE: › used for referring to a man or boy when you cannot remember or do not know his name
名叫某某的他，某個他（用於忘記男子的名字時）

example: Have you invited Mike Whats-his-name to the party?
你邀請那個叫麥克甚麼甚麼的來參加聚會了嗎？

NONE: › used to emphasize your surprise when asking a question
（用在疑問句中強調很吃驚）究竟，到底

example: What in the world are you doing in the cupboard?
你究竟在碗櫃裡做什麼呢？
Who in the world could do such a thing?
到底有誰能做這樣的事？

NONE: › used to mean that you have to do what someone says
不管（某人）說甚麼，都要按其說的去做

example: It was Helen's idea and what Helen says goes.
那是海倫的主意，她怎麼說就怎麼做。

NONE: › used to give emphasis to a question
（用於強調問題）到底，究竟

example: What the devil are you doing?
你到底在做甚麼？
Where the devil have you been?
你究竟去了哪裡？

NONE: › used when you are speaking about something or someone whose name you can not remember
名叫甚麼甚麼的那個人，那個叫某某的東西（用於指記不起名字的人或物）

example: I need a - a whatchamacallit - one of those things that you can caramelize sugar with.
我需要一個——那個叫甚麼來著——可以熔化糖的那個東西。

NONE: B2 it is not important what is; it makes no difference what (is)
不管怎樣，無論甚麼
B1 anything or everything
任何事物；任何東西
› used instead of the word "what" to add emphasis to a phrase, usually expressing surprise
（用於代替 what，加以強調以表示驚訝）到底甚麼，究竟是甚麼
whatsoever
› informal something that is said to show no respect to someone who is asking you to agree with them or agree to do something
（用於有人強迫自己同意其觀點或做某事的的時候）怎樣都行，無所謂

example: We'll go whatever the weather.
無論天氣怎樣，我們都要去。
Whatever happens, you know that I'll stand by you.
你知道無論發生甚麼事情，我都會支持你。
Whatever else may be said of him, Mr Meese is not scared of a fight.
無論別人還說他甚麼，米斯先生並不害怕打上一架。
Whatever the outcome of the war, there will be no winners.
無論戰爭的結果如何，誰都不會是勝利者。
I eat whatever I want and I still don't seem to put on weight.
我想吃甚麼就吃甚麼，仍然不見體重有所增長。
"What can we do tonight?" "It's up to you - whatever you want."
「那我們今天晚上做甚麼呢？」「由你決定──你想做甚麼都可以。」
Whatever I say I always seem to get it wrong.
無論我說甚麼，似乎總是說錯。
Don't, whatever you do, tell Patrick (= you certainly should not tell him).
